C1561.title: Time Tells All: Deanonymization of Blockchain RPC Users with Zero Transaction Fee
C1561.summary: This study presents a zero-transaction-fee deanonymization attack method that leverages mathematical modeling and large-scale measurements to identify blockchain RPC users, exposing on-chain privacy leakage risks.
